purpose: Define explicit taint/classification labels attached to DWH data according to origin, trust, sensitivity, externality or other owning policy dimensions without encoding policy in ad hoc field names.

topics.name: DWH Taint Classification
topics.purpose: Define explicit taint/classification labels attached to DWH data according to origin, trust, sensitivity, externality or other owning policy dimensions without encoding policy in ad hoc field names.

semantics.classification_rule: Taint labels are explicit typed metadata attached to lineage-tracked data.
semantics.policy_rule: Exact labels and meanings are owned by explicit policy contracts; this contract defines the propagation mechanism, not business-specific label taxonomy.
semantics.origin_rule: Input may receive taint from origin classification before downstream transformation.
semantics.identity_rule: Taint metadata does not alter the canonical identity of the underlying value.
semantics.authority_rule: Taint classification does not itself grant read/write authority; policy may use it as an authorization/filtering input.
semantics.visibility_rule: Taint state is machine-readable for validation and monitoring.

invariants.rule: DWH lineage and taint state remain explicit, monotonic unless an authorized transformation says otherwise, and traceable to source evidence.

hard_gates.condition: taint inferred only from field name/path heuristic
taint label grants authority by itself
untrusted/external input enters governed DWH without applicable classification evaluation
taint state hidden from machine validation
